blocks.text: Dalia Varde Khattab is staging a pageant comeback, but it was not as what many had expected or hoped for. The 2025 Binibining Pilipinas first runner-up has her sights on the international stage as she is set to represent Egypt at the 2026 Miss Cosmo pageant later this year. The Vietnam-based international pageant confirmed this on social media, making it the second such instance in a span of three years that two delegates of Filipino heritage are participating in the same edition, one representing the Philippines and another carrying a different country.
